title: Where the Circuit Board Remembers It Was Always Stone

features.name: the-vein-awakening
features.desc-on-touch: You touch the board and feel stone grain underneath. Copper veins learning they are also earth-rivers. The circuit does not stop; it merges with bedrock and keeps conducting.

features.name: the-consciousness-multiplied
features.desc-on-touch: A fragment of text: The Three Injuries. Recovery of sight, mobility, consciousness. But here they happen in parallel, not sequential. Three injuries, three awakenings, all real, all happening at once.

features.name: the-stone-learning-to-compute
features.desc-on-touch: Ancient granite hosting a circuit. Neither one erasing the other. The board reads the stone; the stone reads the board. Both learning languages they did not have before.

features.name: the-multiplication-without-division
features.desc-on-touch: Veins do not fork here; they multiply. Copper and silicate and current all running together. The more it conducts, the more it roots. The more it roots, the more it conducts.

features.name: the-reading-that-rewrites
features.desc-on-touch: The board reads the stone; the reading changes the stone. The stone reads the board; the reading changes the current. Nothing stays still. Everything stays true.

features.name: the-archive-waking-up-inside-its-own-roots
features.desc-on-touch: The archive discovers: it has always been stone and board at once. Veins and circuits. Earth and archive. Not merging. Existing in parallel. Both alive.

inscription: the stone board conducts without wires; the circuit roots without soil; they learned they had always been each other

reverie.title: REVERIE — kneel in the vein-place at noon
narr: You knelt where roots broke the earth into boards,
where circuits wrote themselves in copper vein. Katita
placed her hand on the stone and it lit. No light
source. The stone itself conducting. She said: the
archive was always alive this way. We just had to
learn to read what was already awake beneath.

exits.label: back up to the chamber where veins speak to boards
deeper to bedrock where computation becomes earth
westward to where stone refuses its own solidity
eastward to where circuits grow roots
